name: The Prophet Skeram
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/temple-of-ahnqiraj/skeram.md. Wowhead's 4,264,000 HP is a 'Seasonal 40 Player' value, so HP here is a clock: a 258 s kill. ESTIMATES: the room is drawn from prose (three platforms, 22 to 40 yd apart so a late run costs real Earth Shocks, closer than the real stairs so one tank can walk it). No boss mod carries a timer for Arcane Explosion, Blink or True Fulfillment, so their cadences here are guesses: Arcane Explosion every 16 s, Blink once per phase, True Fulfillment every 28 s. Melee 850 per 2 s (wiki 700 to 1,000) is ~425 per second, scaled so a 10,000 HP tank lives on the raid's passive healing (500 per second) and an ignored tank dies inside 30 s (only 140 per second of healing while a player heals). Arcane Explosion 1,500 is the guide figure, not the 388 base or the wiki's ~200. Earth Shock 1,100 per 1.5 s is between the 654 base and the 'up to 3,000' guide figure. ENGINE GAPS. Blink: phases 2, 4, 5, 7 and 8 are 'Skeram is on that platform' stretches, each opened by a `threatWipe` with `teleportBossTo` at the phase start, because the engine has one tank spot per phase. Blink timing is therefore fixed per phase instead of random. The Skeram you face in each split is the real one by construction; identifying him by mana or a raid marker is not simulated. Arcane Explosion: the '5 or more in melee' trigger (and the 1.12 note that it is no longer guaranteed) cannot be expressed, so it fires on a timer; the raid's real melee count is not simulated either, so the melee role is told the four-melee rule in words but nothing scores it. Without an Interrupt button the healer sees every cast land (read those as the raid's missed kicks). Earth Shock: only `conditional: meleeEmpty` tests for a tank in melee, so it is a 1.1 s debuff on whoever tanks, with the tank taking it instead of the real 'top threat' target, and only for the real Skeram. Images cast Arcane Explosion (`offBoss`) but never Earth Shock, True Fulfillment or Blink. True Fulfillment: a `debuff` with `stun: 20` on a random melee or ranged player (`playerChance` 0.3), the real 20 s charm as a loss of control. It cannot hurt the raid, take a Polymorph or follow the 'closest non-tank' rule, so the +300% damage and the sheep are not represented. It never targets healers: at 20 s a healer cast would take the tank off the raid's healing, and guides put the nearest non-tank at the melee. Images are `killFirst` adds on the 75% and 50% splits, burned over a 24 s `lifetime` estimate (real image HP is unknown, 'far fewer' than the boss); the 25% split uses `killable` images with no priority, so attacking one is scored by `attacksOnAdds` and the raid burns the real boss; images vanish with him at the end. One off-tank role is the left-platform tank: the player holds the left image, a ghost group holds the others (`playerFrom`).

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold Skeram against a wall on his platform. He Blinks without warning: Taunt the moment he appears and be in melee fast, because Earth Shock chains on whoever he has while nobody melees him.

offtank.label: Platform tank
offtank.description: You own the left platform. Every split an image lands there: pick it up and hold it while the raid kills it. On the last split, hold it and let the raid burn the real Skeram.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stay on him, but keep to four melee or fewer on any one Skeram: a fifth makes him cast Arcane Explosion. Kick the casts that do come. Swap to the images on the 75% and 50% splits; on the 25% split ignore them and burn him.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Work from the rails. Kick Arcane Explosion with Counterspell, swap to the images on the first two splits, ignore them on the last.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Heal through melee and the Earth Shocks that follow a late Blink. You have nothing to dispel: True Fulfillment cannot be removed.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

interrupt.label: Interrupt
interrupt.tip: Kick, Pummel, Shield Bash or Counterspell. One button covers them all here, so it reaches the whole room, and it is ready for every other cast.

arcaneExplosion.label: Arcane Explosion
arcaneExplosion.tip: One second to kick it, or 1,500 on everyone within 30 yards.

imageExplosion.label: Image: Arcane Explosion
imageExplosion.tip: An image casts it too. Kick the cast: if you are not sure which Skeram, kick anyway.

earthShock.label: Earth Shock
earthShock.tip: Nobody is in melee, so he shocks his target over and over. Get in melee.

trueFulfillment.label: True Fulfillment
trueFulfillment.tip: A 20 second charm on the closest non-tank. In the raid a mage would sheep you; here you simply lose your character for it.

blinkLeft.label: Blink: left platform
blinkLeft.tip: He teleports and clears his threat table. The tank at that platform must take him now.

blinkRight.label: Blink: right platform
blinkRight.tip: He teleports and clears his threat table. The tank at that platform must take him now.

blinkMid.label: Blink: middle platform
blinkMid.toast: He Blinked to the middle: threat wiped!
blinkMid.tip: He teleports and clears his threat table. The tank at that platform must take him now.

splitRight.label: Summon Images: he appears right
splitRight.toast: Split! He is on the right platform
splitRight.tip: He splits into three. This one is the real Skeram, and his threat is empty.

splitMid.label: Summon Images: he appears in the middle
splitMid.toast: Split! He is on the middle platform
splitMid.tip: He splits into three. This one is the real Skeram, and his threat is empty.

imageMid1.label: Image of Skeram
imageMid1.tip: Two images appear on the empty platforms. The raid kills them first.

imageMid3.label: Image of Skeram
imageMid3.tip: The last split. Tanks hold the images; the raid burns the real Skeram.

imageLeft1.label: Image of Skeram
imageLeft1.tip: Two images appear on the empty platforms. The raid kills them first.

imageLeft2.label: Image of Skeram
imageLeft2.tip: Two images appear on the empty platforms. The raid kills them first.

imageLeft3.label: Image of Skeram
imageLeft3.tip: The last split. Tanks hold the images; the raid burns the real Skeram.

imageRight2.label: Image of Skeram
imageRight2.tip: Two images appear on the empty platforms. The raid kills them first.

expectations.label: Hold him on the middle platform
expectations.tip: Get to him the second he appears and pin him against the wall. Never drag him off a platform.

expectations.label: Stay on the left platform
expectations.tip: Your platform stays covered the whole fight. If he or an image lands on it, you are already there.

expectations.label: Stay on the rails
expectations.tip: From the rails you reach all three platforms. Do not be the closest player to him or you are the next charm.

expectations.label: Nobody finishes an Arcane Explosion
expectations.tip: Every Arcane Explosion is 1,500 on everyone within 30 yards. Kick the cast the moment you see the bar.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: A fresh Skeram after a Blink has no target and throws Earth Shocks at whoever is top threat. Top the tank up the moment he moves.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Melee is 700 to 1,000 a hit. Keep the tank high going into a Blink.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

castsLanded.label: Arcane Explosions that went off
castsLanded.tip: Every completed cast is 1,500 on the raid. Kick on the cast bar.

attacksOnAdds.label: Attacks wasted on images in the last split
attacksOnAdds.tip: On the 25% split the images vanish when he dies. Everything into the real Skeram.

cues.notes: Kick Arcane Explosion on the bar; tank Taunts after every Blink; off-tank grabs the left image.

list.label: Taunt when Skeram turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Kick Arcane Explosion
list.tip: One second. Kick it the moment the bar appears.

list.label: Kick the image
list.tip: The images cast it too. Kick anything that casts.

list.label: Pick up the image on your platform
list.tip: Taunt it or stand on it as it appears.

list.tip: Taunt it or stand on it as it appears.

list.tip: Taunt it or stand on it as it appears.

drills.name: After every Blink
drills.description: He Blinks every 18 s between the left and right platforms. Taunt on arrival and get in melee before the Earth Shocks stack up.

drills.name: Kick the Explosion
drills.description: He casts Arcane Explosion every 9 s: one second to kick it. Ranged and melee both have the button.

drills.name: Grab the image
drills.description: An image appears on your platform every 16 s. Be on it before it walks to the raid.

drills.name: Heal through a Blink
drills.description: A Blink every 16 s with Arcane Explosions landing: keep the tank above half through the shocks.
